selection_rule: GPU fraction<=0.95 and wall<1 for every duplicate geometry/matrix observation in both cohorts; null GPU/wall within5% in both. Minimum worst GPU fraction wins. Original64 otherwise.
scope: Repeated resident one-projection diagnostic/calibration. Null GPU work identical but CPU hook overhead is included; observed variability is not causally attributed. No confidence interval, full-model gain or vLLM ratio.
